name: Orm Stonehoof and the Brutal Helm

meta.wiki: Orm Stonehoof and the Brutal Helm

summary: In Thunder Bluff, Orm Stonehoof has the skill to forge the Brutal Helm. Thun'grim Firegaze sends warriors to him for that work.

sections.title: A Recommendation in Iron
sections.body: Warriors who prove their mettle and assemble pieces of the Brutal Armor in the Barrens are sent up to Thunder Bluff. Thun'grim Firegaze is an accomplished armorsmith, but he knows the work has reached beyond his own skill. He refers the warriors to Orm Stonehoof, whose craft is renowned across Kalimdor. Orm can shape resilient battlefield helms from rare, savage trophies.

sections.title: The Artisan by the Pool
sections.body: Orm Stonehoof lives and works on the high bluffs of Mulgore, near the tranquil pool beneath Thunder Bluff's towering central totem. When a warrior arrives with Thun'grim Firegaze's word, Orm leaves his routine work to discuss the demanding components needed for a helm worthy of the Horde's front lines.

faq.answer: Orm Stonehoof is a skilled tauren armorsmith who lives in Thunder Bluff. Thun'grim Firegaze sends warriors to him for his skill in crafting battle helms.

faq.q: Where can Orm Stonehoof be found?
faq.answer: Orm Stonehoof works near the pool beneath Thunder Bluff's massive central totem.

faq.q: Why does Thun'grim Firegaze send you to Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: Thun'grim Firegaze can craft the chestpiece and other parts of the Brutal set, but Orm Stonehoof has the skill needed to forge the Brutal Helm.
The Brutal Helm is headgear forged for Horde warriors who have reached veteran standing. It requires dangerous materials from beasts across Kalimdor.

faq.q: What does Orm ask for next?
faq.answer: Orm Stonehoof asks you to gather beast trophies for the helm, starting with a Chimaeric Horn from a chimaera in the wild.

faq.q: Can any class take this quest?
faq.answer: No. This line is for warriors who have advanced far enough in their martial training and completed Thun'grim's initial armor work.

angles.text: As a warrior, you are sent to one of the Horde's finest master smiths for heavyweight head protection.
As a member of the Horde, you see orcish weaponmasters in the Barrens work with tauren craftsmen high atop Thunder Bluff.
